hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('file_path',''); (print('Direct edits to _site/ are blocked — edit source files and run quarto render instead.') or sys.exit(1)) if fp.startswith('_site/') or '/_site/' in fp else None"

python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('file_path',''); (print('Manual edits to renv.lock are blocked — use renv to manage R packages.') or sys.exit(1)) if 'renv.lock' in fp else None"
